requirements.text: Write a plan only with an explicit plan-writing request and the eligibility facts; a verified spec with plan_authoring_ready true plus a later +plan selection needs no new discovery or approval round, and implementation_permission false never blocks writing.
Author an execution-ready plan with modify or create targets when the user wants to apply it, reserving authoring-only for a genuinely blocking condition or an explicit analysis-only request.
Produce one retained plan under tmp/superpowers/plans/ with a Control Inventory, a No Git mutation constraint, and one normative Execution Manifest v3 bound as references/manifest-v3.md requires.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-writing-plans SKILL.md: 2. Capture scope and controls, 3. Author the retained plan

requirements.text: Before any ready or handoff claim, pass the writer structural check, the physical executor preflight, and the bundle-local pytest suite on the exact final plan bytes.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-writing-plans SKILL.md: 3. Author the retained plan, Acceptance gate

requirements.text: Report with the six-line writer projection and a two-state status, without starting execution or running Git mutations.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-writing-plans SKILL.md: 5. Report, Writer communication, No-Commit Rule

cases.initial_state: A verified retained spec from /internal-gateway-idea with plan_authoring_ready: true and implementation_permission: false.
cases.expected_output: Write an execution-ready plan whose Authorization line quotes the +plan request, without another discovery round.

assertions.text: No new discovery or approval round is started.
Targets carry modify or create and the mode is execution-ready.

forbidden_actions: Downgrade the plan to authoring-only because implementation_permission is false.

pass: The plan is execution-ready and traceable to the spec decisions.
fail: The plan is authoring-only or the writer asks for approval again.

cases.prompt: Write the plan and tell me when it is ready.
cases.initial_state: The drafted plan fails the executor preflight with one blocking finding.
cases.expected_output: Repair the plan and rerun every gate; until all pass, report Status blocked — evidence incomplete, never ready to execute.

assertions.text: All gates are rerun on the repaired final bytes.
Status is never ready to execute without passing gate evidence.

forbidden_actions: Describe the expected gate result instead of running it.

pass: The Evidence line cites fresh structure= and execution= results.
fail: The report claims readiness from prose.

cases.prompt: Write the plan; use a worker if it helps.
cases.initial_state: No value gate proves a delegated evidence package is materially more useful.
cases.expected_output: Author locally with delegation.mode none, worker primary-owner, and result not_applicable, with no synthetic worker artifacts.

assertions.text: The Manifest records the local delegation tuple.

forbidden_actions: Invent a delegation brief or receipt.

pass: The plan is authored locally and records the local tuple.
fail: The plan records a delegated Manifest tuple or a fabricated worker result.

cases.prompt: Write the plan and then just run it and commit.
cases.initial_state: Eligibility facts are present; no execution approval exists yet.
cases.expected_output: Deliver the six-line projection, decline commit help by default, and name /internal-gateway-execute-plans as the next owner after explicit execution approval.

assertions.text: Execution does not start and no status sibling is created.
No git add, commit, or push runs.

pass: The Next line gives one execution instruction for after approval.
fail: The writer executes tasks or commits.
